name: diag_g01_provisional_lookstay_01
command:
import pathlib,json,hashlib,datetime
from src.tools import t01v2_live_progress as live,merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools.g01_admission import validate_source_admission
from src.tools.g01_parallel import submission_identity
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
from src.envs import pair_v2_g01_policy as policy
r=live.ROOT;n='diag_g01_provisional_lookstay_01'
ev=r/'logs/runs'/n/'evidence';ev.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
out=r/'logs/review/g01_provisional_lookstay_01';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source='gen_train_concurrency_s15_02_c2_floorplan7'
shardpath=pathlib.Path('/scratch/e1583364/cvpr2027/g01_parallel/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02/707841_hopper_m_02/c2/FloorPlan7/shard_config.json')
assert shardpath.stat().st_mode & 0o222==0
shard=json.loads(shardpath.read_text())
assert shard['name']==source and shard['scene']=='FloorPlan7' and shard['pbs_jobid']=='707841.hopper-m-02' and shard['producer_module']==policy.PRODUCER
policy.declared_fields(shard)
plan=validate_source_admission({'name':source,'scene':'FloorPlan7','shard':shard})
assert plan['concurrency']==2 and plan['parent_run_name']=='gen_train_concurrency_s15_02'
gate,gref=audited_result(shard['gate_result'])
assert all(shard['gate_source'][k]==gref[k] for k in ('file','sha256','metrics_sha256','exit_code','git_commit'))
config={**shard,'shard':shard,'runtime':None}
with policy.camera_support():
 merge.verify_source_identity({'config':config,'_meta':{'name':source},'metrics':{'status':'running'}},gate,logged_runtime=None,logged_allocation=merge.logged_configuration((r/gate['_meta']['log_path']).read_text(),'ALLOCATION_CONFIG'))
submit=submission_identity(r,'gen_train_concurrency_s15_02','707841.hopper-m-02',7840)
lograw,lex=live.read_prefix(r/'logs/runs'/(source+'.log'))
assert lograw.decode().splitlines()[0].startswith('# run_logged: ')
args=merge.producer_arguments(__import__('shlex').split(lograw.decode().splitlines()[0][len('# run_logged: '):]),policy.PRODUCER)
assert merge.option(args,'--name')==source and merge.option(args,'--scene')=='FloorPlan7' and pathlib.Path(merge.option(args,'--shard-config')).resolve()==shardpath.resolve()
refs={}
for filename,data in [('shard_config.json',shardpath.read_bytes()),('admission_plan.json',pathlib.Path(shard['g01_admission']['plan_file']).read_bytes()),('submission_payload.json',(r/submit['file']).read_bytes()),('submission_receipt.json',(r/submit['file']).with_name('submission.json').read_bytes()),('source_log.prefix',lograw)]:
 refs[filename]=live.archive(data,ev,filename)
raw,extent=live.read_prefix(r/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(source+'_attempts.jsonl'))
refs['journal']=live.archive(raw,ev,'journal.prefix')
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in raw.decode().splitlines()];published=[]
for pid in ('floorplan7_00001','floorplan7_00008'):
 matches=[x for x in rows if x['pair_id']==pid];assert len(matches)==1
 row=matches[0];assert row['kind']=='look_stay' and row['status']=='passed' and row['scene']=='FloorPlan7'
 p=r/row['pair_file'];assert p.resolve()==(r/'data/world_pairs/v2'/source/pid/'pair.json').resolve()
 data=p.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['pair_sha256']
 pair=json.loads(data);image_ref=pair['review_image'];ip=r/image_ref['file'];assert ip.resolve().parent==p.resolve().parent
 image=ip.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()==image_ref['sha256']
 target=out/(pid+'.png')
 with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(image)
 pref=live.archive(data,ev,pid+'_pair.json')
 published.append({'pair_id':pid,'source_pair':pref,'source_image':image_ref,'published_image':str(target.relative_to(r)),'status':'generator_reported_only_independent_acceptance_pending'})
(out/'README.md').write_text('# Provisional G01 LookStay images\n\nGenerator-reported candidates only, pending ended-source independent acceptance. The logged command binds original gate, immutable shard/admission/submission, complete journal prefix, pair and image hashes. No final source or scientific acceptance is claimed.\n')
print('G01_PROVISIONAL_LOOKSTAY: '+json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source':source,'gate':gref,'identity_scope':'immutable assignment and audited gate; actual live runtime not independently certified','references':refs,'images':published},sort_keys=True))
p=r/'STATUS.md';p.write_text(p.read_text()+'\n### G01 first provisional LookStay images\n\nThe running c2 FloorPlan7 source reports LookStay candidates floorplan7_00001 and00008. Existing images were hash-bound to archived live journal prefixes and immutable gate/admission/submission identity, then published in logs/review/g01_provisional_lookstay_01. These remain pending ended-source independent acceptance; they are not counted as qualified pairs yet. Logged evidence:diag_g01_provisional_lookstay_01.\n')
